text:
Predicates:
LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputOfTask(x, y) ::: y is the output of task x.
TextSequence(y) ::: y is a text sequence.
NaturalLanguageProcessingTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Premises:
∀x (NaturalLanguageProcessingTask(x) → (LanguageGenerationTask(x) ∨ LanguageUnderstandingTask(x))) ::: Natural language processing tasks are either language generation or understanding tasks.
∀x (OutputOfTask(x, y) ∧ LanguageGenerationTask(x) → TextSequence(y)) ::: If the output of a language generation task, then it is a text sequence.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
OutputOfTask(x, y) ::: y is the output of task x.
TextSequence(y) ::: y is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
¬(MachineTranslation(x) → LanguageUnderstandingTask(x)) ::: Machine translation is not a language understanding task.
